title: Sony delays the Pulse Elevate wireless speakers (due 12 Nov) over a production issue

sources.name: PlayStation Blog, 'Update on Pulse Elevate wireless speakers launch', updated 6 Nov 2026 15:15 PST (23:15Z)

first_report: Sony's own update on the PlayStation Blog post, 6 Nov 2026 15:15 PST = 03:15 Dubai 7 Nov; Kotaku 7 Nov 19:59 Dubai
footage: Official Pulse Elevate product videos from the PlayStation.com page (gmedia.playstation.com): the 6 s video block (1920x1080) and the 8.9 s tilt animation (1920x1080), no sound of their own, so our bed. Trailers: none exists for the speakers' delay. Short loops are all the publisher offers.

claims.text: Sony delayed the launch of Pulse Elevate wireless speakers; quote: 'we have identified a production issue with the product and have made the decision to delay the launch'
claims.status: read in full on the PlayStation Blog post, Update November 6, 2026

claims.text: The original launch date was 12 November 2026 (RRP $219.99), announced in the 18 Aug update on the same post
No new date or refund policy stated
claims.status: the Sony update gives no new date; Kotaku says the same; refund policy not stated by Sony, not claimed

angle.hook: A week before launch Sony pulled its first wireless speakers
angle.why_now: Sony's update went up late 6 Nov; the launch was Thursday 12 Nov
angle.players_here: Pre-orders were open worldwide; a new date has not been given
angle.payoff: Sony says the extra time is to deliver the experience it intended; no new date
